name: Tier 1
summary: Our lead partner. Large-size, high-visibility placement across the car, the team and every piece of material we produce — plus direct access to Khalifa University engineering talent.

benefits.livery: Large-size logo on the vehicle body, sidepods and rear wing — high-visibility placement
benefits.kit: Large-size logo on teamwear, front and back
benefits.website: Large-size logo on this site, the team banner, exhibition posters and promotional material
benefits.social: Featured across KU and KUFS social media platforms
benefits.designReport: Large-size logo in the Competition Design Report
benefits.recruitment: Access to KU's top engineering talent for internships and recruitment
benefits.recognition: Acknowledgement in official presentations and media features
benefits.labVisit: Invitation to visit the KUFS lab and attend demonstration or test events

name: Tier 2
summary: Medium-size placement on the car and the team, with recognition through our presentations and outreach.

benefits.livery: Medium-size logo on the vehicle body and rear section
benefits.website: Medium-size logo on this site and the team banner
benefits.social: Included in KU and KUFS social media posts
benefits.designReport: Medium-size logo in the Competition Design Report
benefits.recognition: Acknowledgement during presentations and outreach events, and inclusion in flyers and event materials
benefits.labVisit: Invitation to visit the KUFS lab and meet the team

name: Tier 3
summary: Small-size placement across the car, the team and our published material. Where most of our first partners start.

benefits.livery: Small-size logo on the vehicle body
benefits.kit: Small-size logo on the teamwear sleeve
benefits.website: Small-size logo on this site, the team banner, flyers and event posters
benefits.social: Featured on KU and KUFS social media platforms
benefits.designReport: Small-size logo in the Competition Design Report
benefits.recognition: Acknowledgement during presentations and outreach events

name: In-Kind
summary: Materials, components, machining, software, equipment, logistics or expertise instead of cash. Placement is set by the verified value of what you contribute.

benefits.livery: Placement based on the verified value of the contribution
benefits.kit: Placement based on the verified value of the contribution
benefits.website: Listed on this site with what you supply
benefits.social: Credited when we use what you have given us
benefits.designReport: Credited in the Competition Design Report
benefits.recognition: Acknowledgement during presentations and outreach events, and inclusion in relevant promotional and event materials
